title: Stardust empty-timer repair cohort compatibility check
hypothesis: The frozen Stardust empty-timer repair completes the same four representative cross-race games cleanly, with no in-sync hash mismatch, plausible Protoss worker/building/combat production, and at least 384 durable logical frames per wall second in every game and in aggregate.
stop_condition: Exactly four registered games, run serially, unless interrupted or two consecutive infrastructure failures trigger the existing batch stop. Preserve all attempts. No retries, replacement games, or adaptive seeds.
purpose: Bounded compatibility check of the frozen Stardust empty-timer repair; no rating, performance-causality, or strength-promotion claim

execution.bot_seeds: none; no tested module declares a supported explicit bot RNG control for this schedule

engineering_acceptance.plausible_gameplay: Each completed Stardust replay must contain identifiable worker-production, building-production, and combat-unit command evidence. Record each category and any idle or wrong-race anomaly; absence or an ambiguous client view makes compatibility inconclusive.
engineering_acceptance.definition: logical frame count divided by durable_completion_seconds, including both bots, engine, initialization, logging instrumentation and archive capture; aggregate uses sum(frames)/sum(durable seconds)
engineering_acceptance.clean_result: Opposing winner callbacks, both launcher return codes zero, and no insync_hash_mismatch event in either client diagnostic stderr.

entry_condition: Launch only with the frozen repair artifact after the confirmed empty-timer diagnostic and one-shot correctness probe passed.
